strategy_roster.name: IU EMA Channel
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(100) is applied to high and low to represent the source channels exactly in form. Previous-extreme stops and the 2R target are price-state rules, so their absence is not a numeric percentage setting.

strategy_roster.name: MVO - MA Signal
strategy_roster.notes: EMA 9/21 and a bullish regular candle are explicit fallbacks for Heikin-Ashi moving-average signals because no parameters are supplied. MFI extremes, ATR protection, break-even, and trailing are not retained.

strategy_roster.name: Currencyprofits High-Low Channel
strategy_roster.notes: Fast/slow EMA 32/86 and the previous six-bar low retest are retained with EMA as the default MA type. The fast/slow trend reversal exits; the 170-point stop and risk percentage are not percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Manadi Buy Sell EMA MACD RSI
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(ema(close,9),ema(close,21)) and macd(close,12,26) > macd_signal(close,12,26,9) and rsi(close,14) >= 40 and rsi(close,14) <= 70
strategy_roster.notes: EMA 9/21, MACD 12/26/9, and the documented long RSI band 40-70 are exact. The numeric source percentages 0.015 and 0.03 are retained verbatim in the percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: SilverTrend Signal ReOpen
strategy_roster.notes: EMA 9/21 direction is a fallback for the SilverTrend flip, with the inverse cross closing. Re-entry pyramiding and absolute 1000/2000-point protection cannot be represented in a single-position percentage roster.

strategy_roster.name: WOC 0.1.2 Momentum
strategy_roster.notes: A three-bar move above 1% is an explicit bar-based proxy for the Level1 ask streak because no defaults are supplied. Tick sequence timing, auto lot sizing, stop ticks, and trailing are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Martingale Breakout
strategy_roster.entry_long: high - low > 3 * sma(high - low,10) and close > open
strategy_roster.notes: The current range exceeding three times its ten-bar average and a bullish close retain the documented breakout core. Recovery sizing, account-percentage PnL thresholds, and 50-point targets are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: ROC2 VG
strategy_roster.notes: The documented 8/14 Momentum lines are approximated by percentage ROC(close,n), and the opposite cross exits. Indicator-type variants, inversion, and short-side reversal handling are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Get Rich or Die Trying GBP
strategy_roster.notes: Eighteen-bar positive momentum plus a current bearish candle approximates fading the stronger recent count. Session clocks, cooldown, candle counting, and all pip targets/stops are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Internal Bar Strength IBS Mean Reversion
strategy_roster.notes: The source is short-only while this catalog is long-direction, so no long signal is fabricated and an impossible negative-price guard records that limitation. The 0.9/0.3 IBS thresholds remain short-only rules.
